$comment: #4393: every constant a formal/<family>/*.cfg assigns (`=` or `<-`), and every module `Name == TRUE|FALSE` that is not a `<-` target, is classified here, per family. `pins`: the constant mirrors a code choice; `value` is what every `\* expect: pass` config resolves it to (its `=` value, the definition its `<-` names, or the module's `Name == <literal>`), and `test`/`title` name a test a run reaches, in a file vitest collects, that drives the real code and asserts that behaviour, so flipping the code reds the test and flipping the model alone reds tests/config/tla-switch-pins.test.ts. `also` names further tests when one value encodes several behaviours. `narrowedBy` admits, per value, the named as-built configs (file stems) that use it only to cut the explored schedules, with its reason; a config it does not list must match `value`. `notCodeChoice` and `deferred` groups carry a reason for each member, and tests/config/tla-switch-pins.test.ts pins the counts of deferred and notCodeChoice members exactly, so every move between them is a visible edit. Flipping a model value and this value together, without the code, reds neither the gate nor the pin, so a change to a value here is a reviewer's call. A PR that changes a pinned behaviour flips the constant, its configs and this value together (AGENTS.md shape 68).
